request.query: positive a and kappa greater than b eventually b*x/(x-a*sqrt x) < kappa at infinity

items.name: AkraBazziRecurrence.GrowsPolynomially.eventually_atTop_ge
items.type:
∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ} {b : ℝ},
  b ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 →
    AkraBazziRecurrence.GrowsPolynomially f →
      ∃ c > 0, ∀ᶠ (x : ℝ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (b * x) x, c * f x ≤ f u

items.name: tendsto_bdd_div_atTop_nhds_zero
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : Field 𝕜] [inst_1 : LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜]
  [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace 𝕜] [OrderTopology 𝕜] {l : Filter α} {f g : α → 𝕜} {b B : 𝕜},
  (∀ᶠ (x : α) in l, b ≤ f x) →
    (∀ᶠ (x : α) in l, f x ≤ B) → Filter.Tendsto g l Filter.atTop → Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f x / g x) l (nhds 0)

items.name: AkraBazziRecurrence.eventually_asympBound_r_pos
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] {T : ℕ → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : α → ℝ} {r : α → ℕ → ℕ} [inst_1 : Nonempty α]
  (R : AkraBazziRecurrence T g a b r),
  ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ (i : α), 0 < AkraBazziRecurrence.asympBound g a b (r i n)

items.name: Filter.eventually_lt_add_pos_of_limsup_le
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] [inst_1 : Preorder β]
  [inst_2 : AddZeroClass α] [AddLeftStrictMono α] {x ε : α} {u : β → α},
  Filter.IsBoundedUnder LE.le Filter.atTop u →
    Filter.limsup u Filter.atTop ≤ x → 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ (b : β) in Filter.atTop, u b < x + ε

items.name: LinearGrowth.linearGrowthSup_le_iff
items.type: ∀ {u : ℕ → EReal} {a : EReal}, LinearGrowth.linearGrowthSup u ≤ a ↔ ∀ b > a, ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, u n ≤ b * ↑n

items.name: Filter.Tendsto.num_atTop_iff_den_atTop
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_4} {K : Type u_5} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K]
  [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace K] [OrderTopology K] [ContinuousInv K] {f g : α → K} {l : Filter α} {a : K},
  0 < a →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f x / g x) l (nhds a) → (Filter.Tendsto f l Filter.atTop ↔ Filter.Tendsto g l Filter.atTop)

items.name: AkraBazziRecurrence.GrowsPolynomially.eventually_atTop_nonneg_or_nonpos
items.type:
∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ},
  AkraBazziRecurrence.GrowsPolynomially f → (∀ᶠ (x : ℝ) in Filter.atTop, 0 ≤ f x) ∨ ∀ᶠ (x : ℝ) in Filter.atTop, f x ≤ 0
